definitions.gloss: hairdressing; hair styling; grooming one's hair
definitions.explanation: The act of arranging or styling hair to make it neat and presentable. Composed of 整 (arrange/put in order) + 髪 (hair). Used as a noun or suru-verb.

examples.japanese: {整髪料|せいはつりょう}をつけて{髪|かみ}を{整|ととの}えた。
examples.english: I used hair styling product to arrange my hair.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}の{前|まえ}に{整髪|せいはつ}をしておいたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should groom your hair before the interview.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}の{整髪|せいはつ}に{時間|じかん}がかかるので、{短|みじか}い{髪型|かみがた}に{変|か}えようと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: Styling my hair takes time every morning, so I'm thinking of switching to a shorter hairstyle.

notes:
USAGE:
{整髪|せいはつ} is most commonly encountered in the compound {整髪料|せいはつりょう} (hair styling product — gel, wax, mousse, etc.). On its own, it sounds somewhat formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整髪料|せいはつりょう} (hair styling product)
- {整髪|せいはつ}する (style/groom one's hair)
- {整髪|せいはつ}スプレー (hairspray)

SIMILAR WORDS:
セット refers to styling hair and is the common casual term (e.g., {髪|かみ}をセットする). {整髪|せいはつ} is more formal. ヘアスタイリング is the loanword equivalent used in fashion contexts.
